Ramlila Maidan Booking Costs and AAP Allegations

The Ramlila Maidan in Delhi, a site for protests, has been booked until December, incurring costs of Rs 1.21 lakh per day. The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) has alleged fraud regarding these bookings. Reports indicate that the ground has had three vacant slots this year, raising questions about its accessibility as a protest site.
